definitions.explanation: With deep sincerity and urgency. Used to express heartfelt wishes, prayers, or requests.

examples.japanese: {切|せつ}に{願|ねが}っています。
{平和|へいわ}を{切|せつ}に{祈|いの}る。
{皆様|みなさま}のご{協力|きょうりょく}を{切|せつ}にお{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I humbly and earnestly ask for everyone's cooperation.

notes:
Adverbial form of {切|せつ} (keen, acute). A formal, literary expression conveying deep sincerity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{切|せつ}に{願|ねが}う (to earnestly wish)
・{切|せつ}に{祈|いの}る (to earnestly pray)
・{切|せつ}に{望|のぞ}む (to earnestly desire)
・{切|せつ}にお{願|ねが}いする (to sincerely request)
・{切|せつ}に{感|かん}じる (to feel keenly)

USAGE NOTES:
{切|せつ}に is more formal and literary than simply using とても or {心|こころ}から. It appears frequently in formal speeches, written appeals, and polite requests. It pairs naturally with verbs of wishing, praying, and requesting.
